name: Greek Yogurt
description: Thick, strained yogurt with a tangy flavor. The straining process removes much of the whey and lactose, concentrating the protein. A popular breakfast and snack food, especially among athletes.

faqs.q: Why is Greek yogurt higher in protein than regular yogurt?
faqs.a: Greek yogurt is strained to remove much of the liquid whey, which concentrates the remaining protein. A typical serving of nonfat Greek yogurt has about twice the protein of regular yogurt.

faqs.q: Is Greek yogurt good for gut health?
faqs.a: Greek yogurt that carries a live and active cultures label contains probiotic bacteria that can support gut health. Note that the straining process does reduce the calcium content compared to regular yogurt.
